title: Full Backup
description: Learn how to create and restore full database backups.

data.text: A full database backup backs up the entire database including metadata and all used data pages. It is the foundation for all other backup types.

data.title: Create a full backup
data.content: Backs up the HR database to a file.

data.title: Full backup with INIT
data.content: Creates a full backup, overwriting any existing backup file.
data.code:
BACKUP DATABASE HR
TO DISK = 'D:\backup\hr.bak'
WITH INIT,
NAME = 'HR-Full Database Backup';

data.title: Restore database from full backup
data.content: Restores the HR database from a backup file.

data.title: Full Backup Key Points
points: Use BACKUP DATABASE to create a full backup.
Use WITH INIT to overwrite and WITH NOINIT to append.
Use RESTORE DATABASE to restore from a full backup.
A full backup is the baseline for differential and log backups.
